hero.subtitle: ServiceNow Developer | Cloud & System Administration Enthusiast

about.heading: 🙋 About Me
about.body: I am a ServiceNow Developer currently working at Flex Ltd., where I transitioned from an intern to a full-time role following my B.Tech graduation in May 2023. I specialize in building robust workflows and integrations within the ServiceNow ecosystem, while continuously exploring server administration, Linux environments, and cloud infrastructure.

items.title: ⚙️ ServiceNow
items.body: IT Service Management (ITSM), Custom Applications, Platform Integrations, Workflow Automation.

items.title: 🗄️ CMDB & CSDM
items.body: IRE-based CI creation, CSDM data model governance, Service Graph Connectors, CMDB health KPIs, and Data Manager policies.

items.title: ☁️ Infrastructure & Cloud
items.body: Linux & Unix Environments, Windows Server Administration, Amazon Web Services (AWS).

items.title: 🐳 Containerization & Hardware
items.body: Docker, Self-Hosting, Proxy Servers, Raspberry Pi Home Labs.

items.title: 🤖 AI & LLM Tooling
items.body: Building AI-powered developer tools using Claude & Anthropic APIs. Prompt engineering, structured outputs, and integrating LLMs into enterprise workflows.

items.title: 🔌 MCP Development
items.body: Designing and building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers — enabling AI agents like Claude to securely query ServiceNow instances for incidents, scripts, CMDB, update sets, and more.

items.title: ⚡ Enterprise ServiceNow Integrations
items.body: Developed and maintained key platform workflows and custom applications at Flex Ltd., improving operational efficiency.

items.title: 🔌 SN-MCP-Server
items.body: A read-only MCP server for ServiceNow — lets Claude Desktop and any MCP-compatible AI agent query incidents, scripts, CMDB, update sets & more. Supports multi-instance routing.

items.title: 🏠 Self-Hosted Home Lab
items.body: Configured a personal server ecosystem on Raspberry Pi utilizing Docker containers for network management and proxy services.
